> PKB (Printed KeyBoard) is a custom 42-key wireless split mechanical keyboard designed from scratch in KiCad 10 and SolidWorks, powered by dual Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 microcontrollers running ZMK Firmware.

**10h**

Designed the Schematic from scratch including an I2C bus and switch matrices. I ran out of IO so had to use IO expander but that let me free up some pins that were hard to solder to making my life a lot easier,
